title: Different Timescales, Different Signals: Multimodal Landmark-Visibility Prediction in a Long-Term Webcam Network
abstract: arXiv:2611.18707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scenic visibility is not a single forecasting problem: planning a trip months ahead, deciding whether to go outside today, and judging whether tomorrow will be clear rely on different information. Using a year-scale multimodal archive of Mount Fuji webcams and meteorological observations, we identify a clear hierarchy across timescales. Seasonal climatology provides useful long-range guidance, webcam imagery is the strongest same-day observation (AUC 0.95), and the numerical forecast valid on the target day carries most of the day-specific signal one to three days ahead. Revealing this hierarchy requires evaluation that respects the dependence among cameras observing the same regional weather state: permissive splits substantially overstate multi-day performance, while date-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation reduce the apparent contribution of the current scene and current weather. translated_title: 不同时间尺度，不同信号：长期网络摄像头网络中的多模态地标能见度预测
translated_abstract: 风景能见度并非单一的预测问题：提前数月规划旅行、决定今天是否外出、以及判断明天是否会晴朗，各自依赖于不同的信息。利用富士山网络摄像头和气象观测的年尺度多模态存档，我们识别出了跨时间尺度的明确层级结构：季节性气候学提供有用的长期指导，网络摄像头图像是最强的当日观测手段（AUC 0.95），而在目标日期有效的数值天气预报则承载了未来一到三天的大部分日特定信号。揭示这一层级结构需要采用尊重观测同一区域天气状态的多台摄像机之间依赖性的评估方法：宽松的数据划分会大幅夸大多日预测的性能，而按日期分组和向前时间的评估则会降低当前场景与当前天气的表面贡献。在6,575个摄像头日上，当前的视觉摘要...
tldr: 该研究基于富士山长期网络摄像头与气象数据的多模态存档，揭示了地标能见度预测在不同时间尺度上的信号层级——长期依赖季节气候学、当日依赖摄像头图像（AUC 0.95）、提前1-3天依赖数值天气预报，并强调必须采用按日期分组的严格评估方法以避免夸大多日预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a clear hierarchy of signals for landmark visibility prediction across timescales—seasonal climatology for long-range guidance, webcam imagery as the strongest same-day observation (AUC 0.95), and numerical forecasts for 1-3 days ahead—while demonstrating that date-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation is essential to avoid overstating multi-day performance.
